body.x: H AND COMPANY, (CEO Lee Woo-Hun), participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan.(local time) and introduced a upgraded air cleaner ‘Clair Cube’.

‘Clair Cube’ was selected as BEST OF MIK ES TOP 10 at the exhibition. ‘BEST OF MIK(MADE IN KOREA) CES TOP10’ selected only 10 companies among CES 2018 domestic exhibitors by global news network, Aving news and foreign news reporters from USA, China and other countries considering technological trend and growth potential of the companies and each media will make a final evaluation during the CES exhibition and select the TOP3 for official announcement.

‘Clair Cube’ household air cleaner has been applied with European patented filtering technology. It has better cleaning efficiency than the existing method, and it discharges the cleaned air to the upper part strongly to make the room air more comfortable.

This product polarizes the incoming contaminants at air intake by plasma ionizer generating negative ion and positive ion and pulls the polarized contaminants like a magnet, using the strong electrostatic force of the mounted E2F filter and eliminate it. All kinds of pollutants sticking on the filter are removed by Violet Blue LED sterilizer installed on the product to help maintain the best filter performance.
The ‘Clair Cube’ suing this principle, is to help to remove not only ultrafine dust, but also harmful substances such as viruses, bacteria, allergens, VOCs, and etc.

‘Clair Cube’ is an economical product that uses less than 6W maximum power consumption in high speed mode, so it is less costly to use electricity for 24 hours, 365 days. The filter can be maintained the optimal condition by removing large dust accumulated on the surface in 1~2 months interval, and the recommended filter replacement period is 12 months.

It is designed to blend in every interior with a soft impression by finishing the exterior in a rectangular shape. All models are manufacture domestically, which makes the reliability of the product high. It can manage the indoor air more efficiently in studio, each room in house, and private work space.

On the other hand, CES, the largest IT exhibition in the world, is held every January as sponsored by the American Consumer Technology Association(CTA), an exhibition to be able to understand the trends of the tech and consumer electronics industry of the world at one sight.

Aving News, which has the most reported issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, the world’s top three tech exhibition for the last 11 years, dispatches special news reporters to CES this year as well, report major issues in the world market and introduces Korea’s major companies all over the world.
